tokenHash.description: SHA-256 hex of the token's auth part (dvci_<authPart>), computed client-side

tokenPrefix.description: First 8 characters of the auth part, for display

wrappedDek.description: DEK wrapped client-side under HKDF(keyPart); stored verbatim, server cannot unwrap
